destination.name: Nantong
destination.tagline: Yangtze port city ringed by an ancient moat, with a sacred hill and a trove of small museums.
destination.description: Nantong is a river port on the northern bank of the Yangtze near its mouth, long known for textiles and kites. Its old centre is encircled by the Haohe, a moat-like river lined with museums, parks and Wenfeng Tower. South of the city, Langshan rises above the Yangtze with Buddhist temples that sailors once visited to pray for safe passage. The industrialist Zhang Jian founded one of China's oldest museums here in 1905.

goodToKnow.title: Boats run set times
goodToKnow.detail: Haohe boat trips are listed for 9:30, 14:30 and 18:45 on weekends and holidays. In the evening the lights and fountains come on around 19:00.

goodToKnow.title: Easy from Shanghai
goodToKnow.detail: Trains from Shanghai take about an hour and a half, and from Nanjing about two and a half hours. Check which of the two stations your train uses.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Mild days with highs of 17 to 28 °C in {months} suit the moat and hills, before the wet, hot summer.
